newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi index shows small rise.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi index shows small rise.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Friday on marginal price gains for some counters, bourse officials said.
The index rose 7.20 points to stand at 3044.14. Turnover was 74.224 million shillings on 1,590,431 shares compared to 236.121 million shillings from 5,499,434 shares on Thursday.
Despite some scattered strong trades, brokers said the market was generally subdued partly through a fall in the price of some key shares.
"Barclays Bank of Kenya Ltd has hit an all time low price of 97 while Kenya Airways is still lagging behind at 9.90." said one broker.

There was heavy buying of Kenya Breweries and Credit Finance Corporation on the three-days special board. One lot of 454,524 shares in Kenya Breweries was offered at 52 but bought at 51 while another lot of 915,090 was offered at 50 but was bought 50 cents higher.
Credit Finance Corporation traded 118,500 shares at 19, down from the offer price of 24.
National Industrial Credit rose to 43 from 40.50, Standard Chartered Bank gained a shilling to 44 and National Bank of Kenya eased to 15.70 from 15.85.

On Thursday, Barclays sold its 11 percent shareholding or 4,827,295 shares in National Industrial Credit at 45 shillings per share in the biggest single deal on the bourse since its inception in 1954.

Brokers said the rise in National Industrial Credit showed investor confidence in the new buyers, an insurance concern whose parent holding company has invested millions of dollars in real estate, insurance, maritime business and banking.
